title: BREAKING Saudi Arabia has informed European refiners that they
excerpt:
BREAKING: Saudi Arabia has informed European refiners that they will be allocated no crude oil next month amid the East-West pipeline shutdown, per Bloomberg.

European customers normally receive Saudi Arabian crude oil shipments on "term contracts," which are meant to ensure a steady flow of crude oil supply every month.

Countries in Europe imported 577,000 barrels of crude oil per day from Saudi Arabia prior to the shutdown.

Europe is facing its worst energy crisis in history.

excerpt:
